Som en del av den återkommande uppföljningsprocessen har det i samförstånd med Twaweza och HakiElimu beslutats att utföra effektivitetsrevisioner på respektive organisation. Syftet är att hitta styrkor och svagheter och komma med rekommendationer för förbättring. Vi kommer använda ambassadens ramavtal "Ramavtal för revisionstjänster 2016-2019".
To develop or strengthen capacity of partners in this case Civil Society organizations (CSOs) to be able to able to deliver on mutually agreed results.

Efficiency audit for Twaweza necessitated for a capacity building program on development of organizational risk matrix and board charter. Twaweza was supported by Embassy of Sweden to have such tools in place to improve organizational effectiveness and it is reported that Twaweza is now better positioned to manage risk forecasts and mitigation strategies.
HakiElimu's efficiency audit resulted in strengthening its ICT and financial software to improve its internal financial controls and its component of information technology. It is reported that, necessary financial processess are now automated and ICT system is able to capture organizational different demands for example the need for data protection and security
An assessment of TENMET top leaders recruitment process in 2018 resulted in broadening transparency, openness and alignment to own organization operational manuals.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
